snippet.title: Nephila OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
Nephila is a Metroidvania created by me between 2015 and 2018. I have recently finished porting it from GameMaker Studio 1 to GameMaker Studio 2, so expect updates in the near future, improving the polish and ironing out many issues.

Download and play Nephila now: https://quinn-patrick.itch.io/nephila
Visit my website: quinnsgames.com
